properties.notes: Outline application for the erection of a 4 storey apartment building providing 28 No. one and two bedroom apartments with associated car parking, all matters reserved save for access, layout and scale. Planning Ref: 09/00033/OUTMAJ (2009-04-20); 13/00076/OUTMAJ (2013-04-26); 16/00236/OUTMAJ (2016-05-26). The site has outline planning permission for 28 dwellings. It also has temporary planning permission for use a hospital car park until July 2019 therefore redevelopment of the site is unlikely until after this date. The outline planning permission has been renewed several times as well as the temporary planning permission for use as a car park.
properties.site-address: Hospital Car Park, Preston Road, Chorley
